# Kenyan Magazine

> > Kenyan Magazine: Your comprehensive guide to education, business, entertainment, and lifestyle in Kenya and beyond.

Kenyan Magazine serves as a digital resource covering Kenyan educational institutions (Daystar University, Laikipia University, technical training institutes), telecommunications services (Airtel Kenya, Faiba), local business directories, entertainment news, and lifestyle content including dating advice and global rankings of companies and personalities.

## Key Topics

- Kenya education
- Kenyan universities and colleges
- Certificate and diploma courses
- Nairobi institutions
- Telecommunications in Kenya
- M-PESA payments
- Kenyan business directories
- Technical training institutes
- Contact information guides
- Entertainment and lifestyle
- Global company rankings
- Dating and relationships
- Kenyan celebrities and news
